source_corpus.split_policy: by root: every task from one root shares that root's split

test.role: held-out-evaluation-only; no test prefix examples constructed or used; payload read only for integrity

training.teacher_forcing: every proper witness prefix; no off-path augmentation

diagnostics.note: Completed-layer core traces are retained per task and aggregated by depth. Each depth rate is conditional on tasks that completed that layer; earlier solutions and mid-layer budget exits are right-censored. First-pruned counts likewise cover observed pruning only, not a complete failure-time distribution. Survival is against the recorded witness prefix, which is optimal but not the complete optimal-action set inward. Path survival can also understate state survival when structural deduplication keeps another path to the same state.

primary.question: Does materialized-state rollout solve certified distance 5-8?

protocol.cost_definition: One execution for every type-compatible basis function attempted, including transitions whose function raises. Each beam width is searched independently; a task stops charging when it solves or terminates.
protocol.selection_rule: Lexicographic: distance-5-8 solved, distance-7-8 solved, all-distance solved, lower distance-5-8 mean executions, then narrower beam.
